# Fixture project

Shared rules for every agent in this fixture.

- Keep each fixture file small.

## Agent guide contract
- Generated: `AGENTS.md`
- Sources: `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules/*.md`
- Regenerate: `bash scripts/gen-guide.sh`
- Verify: `bash scripts/check-guide.sh`
- Command files: `scripts/`

## Area notes

- The area rules live in `.claude/rules/area.md`.
